newsitem.title: USA: First Chicago adding supermarket branches.
newsitem.headline: First Chicago adding supermarket branches.

text.p: First Chicago NBD Corp said Tuesday its First National Bank of Chicago will add at least 24 branches in Dominick's Supermarkets Inc stores in the Chicago area in 1997.
This will increase First Chicago's supermarket network to at least 45 locations and its overall Chicago area branch network to more than 150 by year-end.
By the end of the year, First Chicago said its Chicago-area customers will have acess to more than 115 traditional branches.
In early 1997, First Chicago said it will close or consolidate five branches.
